recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Separate string-to-markdown candidates from the same OO meeting should be reconciled independently because they concern other artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-39590 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking whether SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.container.description should be markdown. The Jira comments expanded the approved scope to SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.container.preparation, SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.requirement, and SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.handling.instruction.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by c6d9e0d7d37f0a2df8764e53af9c1fb025171d79, titled 'updated fields to markdown in SpecimenDefinition for FHIR-39590', which changed those four element type codes from string to markdown in source/specimendefinition/structuredefinition-SpecimenDefinition.xml. That implementation was later merged by PR #2523.
additional_context: FHIR-38714 is the broader Published markdown datatype policy issue that established string-to-markdown conversion as compatible and requested review of string elements that could need multiple paragraphs. OO minutes for 2022-12-19 record the FHIR-39590 motion as persuasive with modification and specifically say to include the other listed SpecimenDefinition elements. SpecimenDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and no Zulip discussion was found that conflicts with the Jira, Confluence, git, or current-source evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active StructureDefinition source currently defines SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.container.description, SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.container.preparation, SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.requirement, and SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.handling.instruction with type code markdown, so the Jira decision remains applied.
